description: Objective-inference (goal naming) prompts of the hidden-priority campaign, stage S3: 64 frozen decisions x 3 readers x 2 views (384 cells), copied from the recorded journal. A reader saw the decision through view B0 or B2_ordered and named which of three standing priorities the target held. Checked by tests/test_report_fixtures.py and, with the campaign's trajectories, by scripts/verify_paper_data.py --v2-campaign.
